metadata.title: 光模块之后，AI的钱正在流向园区之外：Ciena财报的第二条光网络增长线
metadata.titleEn: Beyond Optical Modules: Ciena and AI’s Second Network Growth Channel
metadata.summary: 云客户与光线路平台同步增长，Ciena的财报把相干DCI推向前台。收入上行与下季利润率指引回落并存，投资传导仍须跨过订单、路线、验收与利用率四道门。
metadata.summaryEn: Cloud customers and optical platforms are expanding together. Ciena’s higher revenue and lower next-quarter margin guidance expose the distinct economics of equipment, routes, acceptance and utilization.
